research.name: Fire
research.description: Warmth, light and cooked food. Known from the start.

research.name: Foraging
research.description: Knowing which plants feed and which harm. Known from the start.

research.name: Basic Tools
research.description: Stone heads bound to wooden hafts: axes, picks and digging sticks. Unlocks the Toolmaker. Workers without tools work much slower.

research.name: Basic Mining
research.description: Digging into hillsides with antler picks. Unlocks the Mining Pit, a steady source of stone that does not run out.

research.name: Flint Tools
research.description: Mined flint keeps a keener edge than field stone. Tools last 40% longer.

research.name: Spears
research.description: Hafted stone points. Unlocks the Hunters' Camp.

research.name: Tracking
research.description: Reading trails and seasons. Hunting yield +30%.

research.name: Hide Working
research.description: Scraping, curing and stitching hides. Unlocks the Hide Tent and Hide Worker.

research.name: Food Preservation
research.description: Drying and smoking. Unlocks the Drying Rack; all food spoils 15% slower.

research.name: Fishing
research.description: Weirs, lines and spears for fish. Unlocks the Fishing Spot.

research.name: Herbal Knowledge
research.description: Plants that heal. Unlocks the Herbalist, the first health service.

research.name: Storytelling
research.description: Knowledge passed on around the fire. Elders produce 30% more knowledge.

research.name: Kinship
research.description: Families care for each other's children. Births +25%, happiness +5%.

research.name: Seed Gathering
research.description: Noticing which seeds sprout where. Gathering yield +15%.

research.name: Farming
research.description: Planting and tending crops with digging sticks and sickles. Unlocks the Field, the Granary and the Thatched Hut (in the Agricultural Age). Key research for the Agricultural Age.

research.name: Tribes
research.description: Families bound into one people with shared ways. Newcomers join more readily (migrants +30%). Key research for the Agricultural Age.

research.name: Animal Husbandry
research.description: Goats and sheep kept and bred. Unlocks the Animal Pen: meat and hides from open pasture, without hunting.

research.name: Irrigation
research.description: Channels dug from the river to the fields. Fields with water within 10 cells harvest 35% more.

research.name: Pottery
research.description: Fired clay vessels. Unlocks the Clay Pit and the Potter. Sealed jars: every store holds 20% more. Households start to want pottery (the first goods need).

research.name: Weaving
research.description: Spun flax woven into cloth. Fields can be sown with flax, and the Weaver turns the fibre into clothing.

research.name: Healing
research.description: Setting bones, cleaning wounds, nursing fevers. Unlocks the Healer's Hut: health tier 1, wider reach than a herbalist, and it holds back outbreaks.

research.name: Shamanism
research.description: Rites, spirits and the lore of the tribe. Unlocks the Shaman's Hut (research tier 2). From now on people want faith: homes in a shaman's reach have it.

research.name: Tribal Law
research.description: Customs agreed by all. Unlocks the Tribal Council, which calms unrest and passes laws: food sharing, elders settling disputes, shared labour, rationing.

research.name: Masonry
research.description: Dressed stone cut from mined stone. Stone footings: thatched huts can be rebuilt as Stone-footed Huts (houses 10, warmest), and stone-lined wells reach 50% farther.

research.name: Barter
research.description: Organised exchange with other peoples. Trading parties call in spring, summer and autumn, swapping your biggest surplus for what you are short of: tools, clothing, pottery, herbs, or tin.

research.name: Prospecting
research.description: Reading rock for green and grey stains. Reveals the copper and tin deposits on the map.

research.name: Copper Working
research.description: Kiln heat turned on ore. Unlocks the Copper Mine, Smelter and Coppersmith (copper tools: 15% faster work; workers swap up to them).

research.name: Writing
research.description: Marks that keep words. Knowledge is no longer lost between teachers: all knowledge +15%. Key research for the Bronze Age.

research.name: Bronze Working
research.description: Copper alloyed with tin. Unlocks the Tin Mine, Bronze Foundry and Bronze Smith (bronze tools: 30% faster work). Key research for the Bronze Age.
